items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: He works in that pressing shop on Rampart Street. He's wonderful too, yeah.

ctx.x: That's a Jewmaker. Oh yeah. That boy's a good drummer. That's a Pete Rayfield, he got one leg on. Oh yeah, you mentioned. Yeah. Oh, I can handle them over too. He'd lift, he'd play bass drum, you know? He'd do all the fella. He'd do all the fella. That's a good drummer. That's a Pete Rayfield, he got one leg on. He'd do all the fella. I used to like him. That was the Jefferson Racetrack that was taken.
Is Pritchard down here too? That's Pritchard. That's Pritchard there.
He works in that pressing shop on Rampart Street. He's wonderful too, yeah.
